heroSummary: Parkway students start the 2026–27 school year on Tuesday, August 25, 2026. The last regular school day is Friday, May 28, 2027, with a half-day schedule for students in PK–12. calendarNotes: Parkway's academic calendar distinguishes no-school days from districtwide half days and high-school-only finals. Half-day dismissal depends on the student's school tier: Tier 1 dismisses at 11:35 a.m., Tier 2 at 12:20 p.m., and Tier 3 at 1:05 p.m. The December and May finals ranges apply to grades 9–12. Teacher Records Days and the last day of school use the PK–12 half-day schedule. The separate religious-observances calendar is scheduling guidance and does not create additional closure dates. Summer-school dates remain visible after the regular last day but are excluded from the downloadable ICS calendar.

customSections.label: How Parkway Half Days Work
customSections.content: Parkway publishes three dismissal tiers rather than one districtwide half-day time. The district calendar lists all three dismissal times but does not identify which schools use each tier, so families should confirm their school's tier before arranging pickup. High school finals are half days for grades 9–12. Teacher Records Days and the last day of school use the PK–12 half-day schedule. On district early-release days, Parkway Early Childhood dismisses preschool students by noon, and afternoon classes do not meet.

customSections.label: Religious Observances Are Planning Guidance, Not Closure Dates
customSections.content: Parkway's separate religious-observances calendar lists many faith traditions and highlights five observances when schools and teachers are asked to avoid events, testing, or major projects. It also says testing or major projects should be avoided the following day. These observances are not additional days off. We keep them separate from districtwide closure dates.

sourceReviewSummary: Reviewed August 17, 2026, against Parkway's District Calendar page, the current 2026–27 academic PDF, the separate religious-observances PDF, and the Parkway Early Childhood calendar page.
sourceReviewDetails: We verified every published academic-calendar entry against the one-page PDF currently linked by Parkway, including overlapping December and May finals and PK–12 half days.
We record multi-day finals, Thanksgiving, Winter Break, Spring Break, and summer-school ranges exactly as Parkway publishes them rather than inferring dates from adjacent entries.
Half-day dismissal times were checked visually because the PDF's tier table carries information not repeated in the event list.
The Parkway Early Childhood calendar page was checked separately because preschool early-release instructions are not included in the academic PDF's tier table.
Religious observances remain separate from closure events because Parkway presents that PDF as awareness and scheduling guidance.

The observances PDF's visible page is titled 2026–2027, while its embedded document Title metadata still says 25–26 Parkway Planning Calendar. This page follows the visible calendar content and Parkway's official 2026–27 link label.

calendarFaqs.q: When do Parkway students return after winter break?
calendarFaqs.a: January 4 is a Teacher Records Day, so there is no school. Students return Tuesday, January 5, 2027.

calendarFaqs.q: What time does Parkway dismiss on half days?
calendarFaqs.a: The 2026–27 calendar lists 11:35 a.m. for Tier 1, 12:20 p.m. for Tier 2, and 1:05 p.m. for Tier 3. Confirm which tier your school uses. Parkway Early Childhood says preschool students are dismissed by noon on district early-release days and afternoon classes do not meet.

calendarFaqs.q: When is the last day of school for Parkway in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: The last regular school day is Friday, May 28, 2027. It is a half day for grades PK–12.

calendarFaqs.q: Are Parkway religious observances no-school days?
calendarFaqs.a: Not automatically. Parkway's separate observances calendar provides awareness and scheduling guidance; use the academic calendar to identify districtwide closures.

calendarFaqs.q: Are Parkway summer-school dates included in the downloadable calendar?
calendarFaqs.a: No. Summer-school dates after the regular school year remain in the complete date list for enrolled students but are excluded from the downloadable ICS calendar.
